definitions.explanation: Having a very fine, sharp cutting edge. Used for blades, knives, and other cutting instruments. Can also describe a sharp intellect or piercing gaze figuratively.

examples.japanese: {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鋭利|えいり}な⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The culprit was carrying a sharp knife.

examples.japanese: {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治|なお}り→治る：19598_naoru⟧にくいこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Wounds from sharp blades can sometimes be slow to heal.

notes:
Describes the sharpness of a blade or edge, emphasizing that it can cut easily. Often encountered in news reports about crimes or accidents, as well as in cooking and craft contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧: sharp-edged tool/blade
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧: sharp knife
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧: sharp blade/edge
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{凶器|きょうき}→凶器：16384_kyouki⟧: sharp weapon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: sharp — more general; used for blades, pain, eyes, intuition
- ⟦{切|き}れ{味|あじ}→切れ味：19110_kireaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: having a good cutting edge — practical, about performance
- ⟦{尖|とが}った→尖る：00405_togaru⟧: pointed, sharp — about shape rather than edge quality

REGISTER:
More formal and literary than ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧. Common in written descriptions, news reports, and technical contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ is more natural.
